summary: Harden the six-step booking journey into a professional, accessible appointment-request experience
changes: Rebuilt the shared footer as a premium dark editorial section used across every public page
Added a global appointment conversion panel with a direct booking action
Organized Explore, Shop and Client care destinations into accessible navigation groups
Added WhatsApp contact access, store support routes, trust messaging and PressCreates LLC technology attribution
Added responsive one-column mobile and four-column desktop footer layouts within a 1140px boundary
Upgraded the primary header with a constrained 1140px luxury layout and dark top rule
Added refined logo detailing, animated navigation indicators and elevated booking CTA feedback
Rebuilt the bag control with a readable desktop label and removed the distracting zero-count badge
Grouped header actions for cleaner responsive alignment while preserving all routes and mobile navigation
Rebuilt the services grid as a rigid editorial card system within a 1140px cream canvas
Standardized every service card with a 4:5 media crop, equal-height content body and fixed internal rhythm
Added rose serif index badges, espresso typography and restrained luxury hover and keyboard-focus states
Preserved direct service-to-booking routes for all eight existing DE_JOY services
Added the selected design image URL first in every generated WhatsApp appointment request
Added the selected service image URL as the second visual reference in every generated WhatsApp request
Added a booking assurance bar covering completion time, personal confirmation and no-payment expectations
Added precise current-step context and a one-action booking reset control
Required and validated WhatsApp contact details before preparing the final request
Prevented past appointment dates and formatted selected dates for clearer review
Improved live-summary status, confirmation language and appointment-request disclosure
Scoped booking summary styles to prevent generic aside elements from inheriting booking presentation
Completed a homepage-only source and screenshot usability audit from hero through final conversion section
Constrained the desktop hero to a professional 34–38rem responsive range without cropping its content
Improved hero heading scaling and mobile line-height while preserving the approved image and copy
Raised supporting text, trust labels, service links and final CTA copy to more readable professional sizes
Converted service-routing panels into consistent 16:10 image-led cards with restrained lift and zoom effects
Added eager high-priority loading for the hero image and lazy loading for below-the-fold imagery
Simplified the mobile value strip to one scannable benefit per row and tightened mobile section rhythm
Preserved keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and existing booking paths
Added Paystack and Flutterwave hosted-checkout initialization with Paystack active in test mode by default
Added manual bank-transfer settings as an independently enabled checkout fallback
Added owner-only payment settings with provider toggles, active-gateway selection and test/live modes
Added environment credential readiness, webhook status and recent transaction visibility
Added cryptographically random payment references and checkout authorization tokens
Added signed Paystack and Flutterwave webhook validation plus server-side transaction verification
Added amount, currency, provider and reference matching before orders can be marked paid
Added payment transaction persistence and responsive Shopify-style admin payment UI
Updated checkout to present configured methods and redirect online payments to provider-hosted pages
Added payment success and failure states plus automated gateway security tests
Added an owner-only Security workspace for password rotation, active-session review and session revocation
Recorded admin login, password, settings and product lifecycle events in an append-only audit history
Added session device, network and last-seen metadata with automatic expired-session cleanup
Protected permanent product deletion and store configuration behind the owner role
Added timing-consistent login verification and stronger first-owner password requirements
Validated all store settings inputs before database writes
Added automated security regression tests and two independent CI verification passes
Diagnosed the empty Shop All page as a static-hosting/runtime mismatch
Added a resilient seven-product storefront fallback when the public products API is unavailable or empty
Restored complete Product typing for created dates and best-selling sort counts
Added render.yaml for a Docker web service, private PostgreSQL connection, health check and persistent upload disk
Locked PostgreSQL external access while retaining Render private-network connectivity
Corrected deployment documentation to prohibit static-only production hosting
Completed a source-level usability audit after the hosted URL was blocked in the cloud testing browser
Rebuilt product detail pages with primary media, selectable thumbnails, quantity controls, stock messaging and expandable assurances
Added clear add-to-bag confirmation states and secondary-image hover previews
Upgraded the cart with linked products, line totals, quantity labeling, estimated total and checkout assurance
Upgraded checkout with autocomplete, submission locking, error alerts, item thumbnails and policy acknowledgment
Enhanced search with collection suggestions, result counts, loading treatment and a recoverable no-results state
Enhanced admin Orders with status tabs, counts, search and inline fulfilment controls
Rebuilt Shop All with breadcrumb-led hierarchy, a three-column product grid and responsive collection layout
Added collection, availability and naira price filters with clear-filter states
Added eight sort modes: Featured, Newest, Best selling, price, alphabetic and Oldest
Published seven named nail variations using the existing booking-page photography and placeholder naira pricing
Rebuilt the admin Products index with status views, search, counts, selection and bulk deletion
Introduced a Shopify-inspired two-column product editor for content, media, pricing, inventory, status and organization
Added multi-image uploads with a 12-image limit, primary-image treatment and per-image removal
Added permanent product deletion with uploaded-file cleanup and explicit confirmation
Improved responsive behavior, keyboard focus treatment, status badges and WCAG-oriented labeling
Enabled a restrictive Content Security Policy and production security headers
Added bounded in-memory rate limiting for owner setup, admin login, order creation and order tracking
Sanitized inbound request IDs and disabled Express technology disclosure
Hardened admin session cookies, expired-session cleanup and malformed-origin handling
Restricted uploads by field, count, size, MIME type, server-generated extension and file signature
Prevented internal exception leakage and added request IDs to safe production error responses
Added explicit API 404 behavior, no-store API caching and graceful database shutdown
Required production DATABASE_URL and a minimum 32-character SETUP_TOKEN
Hardened the Docker runtime with deterministic checks, dumb-init and post-mount privilege dropping
Added a private vulnerability reporting policy
Added least-privilege GitHub Actions typecheck and production-build verification
Added grouped npm and Docker dependency monitoring through Dependabot
Mapped all seven resilient starter products into the public Nail Care and Press-ons collections
Centralized punctuation-safe collection handle normalization for links and filters
Scoped availability counts to the active collection instead of the full catalog
Preserved Shop All, sorting, price filters, inventory controls and the approved visual design
deployment: Set Paystack and Flutterwave test secret keys and webhook verification secrets in the Render web service environment
Register the production /api/payments/paystack/webhook and /api/payments/flutterwave/webhook URLs in provider dashboards
Complete provider test transactions before changing the admin payment mode from test to live
Deploy as the Docker web service so PostgreSQL-backed security and admin APIs are active
Confirm the schema migration creates admin_audit_logs and extends existing admin_sessions safely
Merge this hotfix so the current static storefront immediately displays the starter catalog
Create or sync the render.yaml Blueprint to provision the dynamic commerce web service
Move dejoyartistry.com from the static service to the new web service after health and admin checks pass
Retrieve SETUP_TOKEN from the Render web service environment and create the owner account at /admin
After merge, allow the Docker build to run npm run check before promoting the web service
Verify CSP, admin login throttling, uploads and graceful health checks in staging before moving the domain
After merge, verify Shop All displays 7 products, Nail Care displays 3 products and Press-ons displays 4 products
